research_question: Does decomposing medium-horizon gold direction into trend continuation versus momentum reversal, and routing between role-consistent specialists, improve two-sided directional quality over the existing H20 selective quantile baseline?
correction_motivating_hypothesis: Earlier general models treated heterogeneous engines as interchangeable direction features or votes; roles are not interchangeable.
V1.56 showed raw accuracy can be inflated by one-sided UP predictions; balanced accuracy, MCC and both-direction support are mandatory.
V1.57 injected realized semivariance into a generic return-quantile model, although the commodity literature motivates realized semivariance specifically as information about momentum reversal.
EMERGENCY_REVERSAL is an alert/context engine, not a persistent daily direction vote; V1.58 uses frozen emergency geometry only as reversal-router context.
The H20 lane has repeatedly shown stronger two-sided structure than H1/H10, so V1.58 tests H20 as the sole primary lane rather than continuing to force short-horizon direction.

source.research_endpoint: XAU/USD exact 13:29 America/New_York research cache bar
source.emergency_geometry_semantic: research-clock reconstruction of frozen 4-percent level/reversal geometry; NOT canonical NY17 EMERGENCY engine output
source.historical_reconstruction_warning: 2023-2026 research panels and cross-market histories are retrospective reconstructions; this contract creates no prospective or production claim

target.trend_definition: sign of origin-observable trailing 20-session cumulative log return (mom20); zero or missing trend => NO_SIGNAL
target.reversal_label: 1 iff sign(future H20 log return) is opposite to trend_definition; otherwise 0
target.direction_mapping: reversal => opposite trend sign; continuation => trend sign
target.overlap_warning: H20 targets overlap; observations are not independent

training.maturity_rule: only rows j with j+20 <= current origin index may enter training

router.primary_rule: p_reversal>=0.60 => opposite trend; p_reversal<=0.40 => trend; otherwise NO_SIGNAL
router.confirmed_rule: p_reversal>=0.60 => opposite trend; p_reversal<=0.40 only emits continuation when frozen H20 RTQ selective baseline agrees with trend; otherwise NO_SIGNAL

benchmark.semantic: existing selective quantile H20 baseline, recomputed without modification

evaluation.benchmark_comparison: compare final routed direction to H20_BASE_RTQ_R126 by period; no claim from raw accuracy alone
evaluation.conditional_predictive_ability: report regime/context slices descriptively; no post-score threshold changes
evaluation.multiple_search_warning: V1.51-V1.58 reused researcher-visible historical outcomes; no specification-search superiority claim without future prospective evidence and search-adjusted inference
